Category: live layout measurement — migration plan §5 founder decision 2026-09-19 ("A value measured from the browser at run time... is written to a CSS custom property. It is a measurement, not a chosen colour or size."); commit d45146f13 classification. AppShell.tsx::applyMetrics reads visualViewport/window.innerHeight via computeAppMetrics and writes the resulting `appTop` string with document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--app-top', appTop) (src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx lines 111-114) — the on-screen-keyboard/safe-area top offset fix. This is a live browser measurement, not a colour or design-scale value; --app-top is not a colour-named custom property so it gets no measurement exception waiver — it is registered here exactly.

Category: live layout measurement — migration plan §5 founder decision 2026-09-19; commit d45146f13 classification. Same applyMetrics site as --app-top above, this time writing the measured `appVh` (visual-viewport height unit) with document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--app-vh', appVh) (src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx line 115). A live browser measurement written to a CSS custom property, not a chosen colour or size.

Category: the user-adjustable root font — migration plan §5 Stage B closure; founder-approved permanent category alongside user-authored colours and live layout measurement; commit d45146f13 classification. ProfileSection.tsx's settings-screen useEffect writes the user's chosen font-size preference with document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--user-font-size', `${fontSize}px`) (src/components/settings/ProfileSection.tsx lines 181-182), driven by the `fontSize` useState the user adjusts with the settings slider (line 66, bound to the same slider at line 275). The value is governed where the user sets it (the accessibility font-size control), not at this root-level write site.
